## Description

Combines Takens' phase-space reconstruction embedding with Neural Ordinary Differential Equations to model continuous-time chaotic price trajectories.

## Where it may fit

Intraday high-volatility regime transitions, sudden liquidity shifts, and non-linear momentum phase transitions.

## Vehicles

High-Frequency Trading (HFT) firms, statistical arbitrage funds, crypto proprietary trading desks.

## Required data

High-frequency OHLCV tick data, reconstructed phase-space embedding vectors, time-stamped market micro-state variables.

## Caveats

Requires continuous-time differential equation numerical solvers (e.g., torchdiffeq) and GPU infrastructure; sensitive to time-embedding delay parameter selection.
